benchmark_evidence.status: Experimental measurements with passing data audits; source/native/resource/semantic qualification remains HOLD.
benchmark_evidence.gnu_comparison: GNU Emacs 31.1 bytecode vs NeLisp native ON; nine workloads, seven pairs per row; high-count kernel and process seconds are in evidence/gnu-all-time-comparisons.json. It is not strict qualification.
benchmark_evidence.same_count: Old vs new NeLisp, fixed counts, CPU 12, two warmups; some original rows reused authenticated identical-count evidence and three changed rows were freshly measured. Historical driver availability was interrupted after sampling; exact bytes were recovered and authenticated. No old execution was repeated.
benchmark_evidence.interpretation: Observed timings motivate questions only. Do not infer causality, strict acceptance, or performance promises.
